subject: Amenity allocation and committed rights — term clarifications
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@oliveevents.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: ops@oliveevents.com
Date: 2026-09-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Revised term sheet and amenity asks

Hi Dylan —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Attached is olive_term_sheet_v2.pdf with the updates we discussed. A few clarifications I wanted to call out so we’re explicit on the record:

- Demo kiosk allocation: 6 hours per day (preferred morning block 9–12); we’ve put three adjacent demo footprints near the main aisle on the site map.
- Backstage / green room access: 2 people per session, 30 minutes prior and 30 minutes after.
- Dedicated charging station branding: one branded charging tower in the lounge.
- Right-to-swap clause: you requested the ability to swap a speaking slot with a partner within 30 days of event; we’ve added a limited swap permission subject to organizer approval.

I flagged the spots in the site map and stage_floorplan_A3.pdf. If any of these items are blockers for your internal sign-off, let me know specifically which line items and I’ll escalate.

If you’re good with these semantics, I’ll prep a DocuSign envelope and send for signature.

Best,
Elaine Park
Senior Partnerships Manager
Olive Events

--

Attachment: venue_site_map.png (PNG, 560KB)
Attachment: stage_floorplan_A3.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@oliveevents.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, logan.wright@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-19T10:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revised term sheet and amenity asks

Elaine — thanks for the quick turn. I reviewed the term sheet and the attachments. High level: we like the structure but need to tighten two items before Legal/Finance can approve.

1) Demo kiosk hours: we can commit to 6 hours/day but need guaranteed morning block 9–12 for at least one demo footprint (the other footprints can be flexible). Please mark one kiosk as "priority morning" on the site map or in the term sheet.

2) Right-to-swap: Redwood needs the ability to swap a session with a named partner (Cobalt Ventures) up to 14 days prior, not 30. Organizer approval is fine but should not be unreasonably withheld — propose an escalation path (written confirmation from Olive within 48 hours).

Additionally, we want to confirm the backstage access language: the sponsor pass should allow two production staff + one speaker to access the green room and load-in access 60 minutes prior (not 30).

Looping in Marissa for fulfillment details and Logan for budget/SLA sign-off. If these three small tweaks are okay I can get Legal to fast-track the DocuSign.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Senior Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-19T13:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revised term sheet and amenity asks

Dylan / team — I reviewed the attachments and Elaine’s notes. Quick counters and operational asks so we have clear SLAs in the term sheet: 

- Priority morning kiosk: fine. Please ask Olive to number kiosks and commit "Kiosk B" for Redwood mornings 9–12 for all three event days. We need that in writing in the exhibit addendum.
- Swap window: we can accept 14 days but only if the swap is documented via the organizer portal AND Olive confirms in writing within 48 hours. Add a clause: "If organizer does not respond in 48 hours, swap is auto-approved." (This prevents subjective denials.)
- Green room: accept 60 minutes pre/post, but request one dedicated 6'x8' prep table and two electrical drops with 15A each. Add to backstage rider.
- Charging tower: branding footprint limited to 1.5m x 1.5m — we need the artwork deadline in the term sheet (30 days out).

Operational note: Priyom — logistic cost estimate for the extra electrical drops? If we have to fund electrician on-site, we should capture cost share with Olive.

If Olive can confirm these edits, and include the kiosk number and artwork deadline, we can approve DocuSign.

Marissa Cole
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
